basic_details.job_title: SIC Maharashtra Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Under Secretary and Section Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: State Information Commission Maharashtra (SIC Maharashtra) Under Secretary (Law) and Section Officer Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of State Information Commission Maharashtra (SIC Maharashtra). A total of 3 vacancies have been announced through the SIC Maharashtra Under Secretary (Law) and Section Officer Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Retired Government Officers Group A and Group B
qualification.details: Under Secretary (Law): Retired Under Secretary (Law) Group A Gazetted Section Officer: Retired Section Officer Group B Gazetted with computer knowledge

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://sic.maharashtra.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://sic.maharashtra.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SIC Maharashtra recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the SIC Maharashtra recruitment is 10th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this SIC Maharashtra recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for two posts: Under Secretary (Law) and Section Officer. There are a total of 3 vacancies for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility criteria for the Under Secretary (Law) post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Under Secretary (Law) post, candidates must be retired Under Secretary (Law) from Group A Gazetted services.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Section Officer post, candidates must be retired Section Officers from Group B Gazetted services and should possess computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the Under Secretary (Law) post is S-23 (₹67,700-₹2,08,700), and for the Section Officer post, it is S-20 (₹56,100-₹1,77,500).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their submitted documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this SIC Maharashtra recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of SIC Maharashtra. Direct links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: This is a contract job. Candidates will be appointed on a contractual basis for the specified period as per the terms and conditions in the official notification.
